sellerlookup.screen.title: Seller Lookup
sellerlookup.screen.enabled.tooltip: Hold Shift or Ctrl over a listing to type a command about its seller.
sellerlookup.screen.hint.tooltip: Under each listing, show what holding Shift or Ctrl would type, so you can see the seller was read right.
sellerlookup.screen.hold.tooltip: How long to hold the key over a listing. A quick shift-click still works, and clicking while you hold cancels it.
sellerlookup.screen.command.tooltip: Typed into the chat, not sent: press Enter to send it. {seller} becomes the seller's name. Leave it empty to turn this key off.
sellerlookup.screen.info: {seller} becomes the seller's name · nothing is sent until you press Enter
sellerlookup.screen.reset.title: Put the settings back to their defaults?
